name: av_treasury_yield
description:
US Treasury constant-maturity yield (percent) for one maturity from Alpha Vantage (TREASURY_YIELD), daily, weekly or monthly.
Returns: {name, interval, unit, data: [{date, value}]} with values as strings, newest first.
Inputs (* required): maturity (3month, 2year, 5year, 7year, 10year or 30year; default 10year); interval (daily, weekly or monthly; default monthly).
Other sources: fred_10yr_treasury, fred_2yr_treasury, fred_yield_spread; policy rate: av_fed_funds_rate.
Example: {"maturity": "2year"}
